parsed.scene_description: An indoor public space with a large curved wooden counter in the foreground. Behind it, tall wall-mounted shelves filled with books extend to a high ceiling. A central decorative spiral structure hangs from above. Several people are seated at tables on the right side, while others stand near the bookshelves. The room features modern lighting and blue-tinted glass walls.

objects.label: curved wooden counter
objects.observation: Large curved surface made of light-colored wood in the immediate foreground. Smooth finish with no visible supports or attachments to other objects.

objects.label: wall-mounted bookshelves
objects.observation: Tall vertical shelving units mounted on the left wall containing books. Illuminated by under-shelf lighting. People are standing in front of them.

objects.label: spiral hanging structure
objects.observation: Multi-tiered cylindrical object suspended from the ceiling center. Contains circular lights and appears to be decorative.

objects.label: orange chairs
objects.observation: Several orange upholstered chairs with metal bases arranged around tables on the right side. Some are occupied by seated individuals.

objects.label: round tables
objects.observation: Small round tables with dark tops and metal legs positioned near the orange chairs. Some have people sitting at them.
